reviews.title: Micah’s Transformation: How a Senior Dog Found Puppy-Like Joy Again with This Joint Duo!
reviews.body:
This is the story of Micah, a 10-year-old dog who lost his ability to climb stairs and jump onto his favourite spot on the sofa. We followed a vet-prescribed regimen of Dasaquin and a physiotherapy programme with little success. My heart sank. I felt powerless as I watched him decline.
Within three months of starting UC-II collagen and Nordic Naturals Omega-3 Pet fish oil, Micah could navigate the stairs with ease, and was truly loving his long walks again. Because of this success,  I have started my youngest dog on this supplement  combination as a proactive measure to protect her joints before issues even begin.
Quick Reference: Pros & Cons
✅ Pros:
• Exceptional Purity: lab tested for contaminants and Zero fishy odour, indicating exceptional freshness.
• Superior Packaging: Glass bottles protect the integrity of the omega oils better than plastic.
• Highly Bioavailable: Sourced from sustainable sardines and anchovies, comes in triglyceride form for maximum absorption.
• Winning Synergy: Works effectively alongside UC-II collagen for senior dog mobility and a healthy skin and coat.
❌ Cons:
• Storage Requirements: Must be refrigerated ❄️ and used within 3 months of opening to ensure potency.
• Premium Price: 💰More expensive than plastic-bottled alternatives, though for me, the quality justifies the price.
• Dosing Detail: The bottle lacks a dropper, which can make precise dosing for very small dogs a little messy without a separate syringe.
Quality & Freshness Indicators 🔍
One of the main reasons I trust this brand is the lack of a strong fishy odour. In my experience, a heavy smell often points to oxidation, but this pure fish oil always smells remarkably fresh. This, along with the company’s commitment to lab testing every batch of oil gives me peace of mind that I am giving my pets the best and safest fish oil on the market.
I also like that it’s sold in blue glass bottles; glass is non-reactive and provides a superior barrier against oxygen and light compared to plastic, which is essential for protecting delicate omega-3 fatty acids.
Micah’s Remarkable Transformation: The Science 🧪🧬
Both of my dogs are at risk of joint pain and stiffness, but the results have been most profound for Micah. After he deteriorated on his initial vet regimen, we switched from Dasuquin to UC-II collagen. I quickly realised that the synergy between the fish oil and UC-II was the missing piece of the puzzle.
• How Fish Oil Helps: These essential fatty acids (EPA and DHA) are potent anti-inflammatories. They work by shifting the body away from producing pro-inflammatory molecules, reducing joint pain and limiting the enzymes that destroy cartilage.
• How UC-II Collagen Works: Unlike traditional supplements, UC-II (undenatured type II collagen) is a science-based regimen that works through "oral tolerance". It signals the immune system to stop attacking joint tissue and instead begin repairing it.
The Time Frame⏳
• 0-2 months: No change
• 2-3 months: Micah’s ease of movement improved. He transformed back into a playful, active dog!  🎾 Seeing him so mobile and thriving in his senior years makes me incredibly thankful!
• 3-6 months: Micah’s physiotherapist continued to note improvements in his exercise tolerance and joint comfort.
Palatability and Sensitive Stomachs 😋
My dogs are discerning characters. They won't entertain spoiled oil - and they shouldn't have to! They remain excited by the mere sight of this unflavoured pet supplement. For pets with sensitive stomachs, I highly recommend starting with a half-dose and gradually increasing it over a month to give their gut bacteria time to adjust to the change.
✅ Final Verdict: Nordic Naturals Omega-3 Pet fish oil is investment in your pet's long-term health. It is also a slow burn; it may take 3-6 months to see its full comfort. I recommend giving it alongside UC-II collagen for joint health. To support an ageing pets mobility and for prioritising proactive care for a younger pet, it is a fantastic choice. I hope my perspective helps fellow devoted pet parents! 🐾💕
reviews.date: Reseñado en el Reino Unido el 20 de diciembre de 2025
